text:
mia: Fyi I'm seeing a reproducible quality regression on the compact reranker (v3-small q8) vs our fp16 baseline. Short factual queries and docs with inline markup are the worst offenders. Posting quick findings.

sam: metrics? which holdouts show it?

mia: ndcg@10 down ~1.9% overall for short-factoid holdout, mrr down ~1.0%. Long-doc slices unaffected. Seems correlated with raw doc text that contains HTML/Markdown.

luke: could be tokenizer differences or quantization-induced embedding shifts around punctuation. Do you have a repro script?

mia: ran the eval harness with a flag to toggle html stripping. Example: query "when was Ada Lovelace born?" and doc variants with/without <em>/<strong> tags. With raw html the q8 model ranks a different snippet. When we strip tags before tokenization the gap disappears.

anya: do you have concrete numbers?

mia: yes:
```
python -m eval.harness --model rerank-q8 --holdout short-factoid --norm html_strip=false --seed 101
# ndcg@10: 0.806
# mrr: 0.627

python -m eval.harness --model rerank-fp16 --holdout short-factoid --norm html_strip=false --seed 101
# ndcg@10: 0.825
# mrr: 0.636
```
With html_strip=true q8 moves to 0.824 ndcg@10.

sam: that implies formatting + quant interaction. Try q8-hybrid (last-layer fp16) to see if logits layer is the problem.

mia: q8-hybrid reduces the gap to ~0.4% ndcg, q4f16 matches hybrid.

luke: likely earlier-layer quantization perturbs subtoken representations around angle brackets. Mitigation: enforce HTML/markdown stripping in the onboarding pipeline by default for compact quant models.

anya: we should add a pair of automated checks to the quant onboarding: 1) tokenizer-parity check (token ids for a small sample must match fp16 tokenization) and 2) ndcg-smoke against a short-factoid-html holdout with threshold (delta < 1%). I'll draft a PR.

sam: also add a top-k overlap metric between fp16 and quant outputs (Jaccard of top-5 passages). That gives a signal about whether results are wildly different vs minor reorders.

mia: running the smoke now. eval-bot output expected shortly.

eval-bot: smoke run finished: ndcg delta vs fp16 = 0.009 (PASS), top5 overlap = 0.82, tokenizer-parity = FAIL (4/50 mismatches). Full logs: https://go/reports/3501000002

mia: tokenizer-parity fail is worrying. I'll produce token id diffs and upload. Link incoming.

luke: if token ids differ we can short-circuit to config/vocab mismatch or tokenization code path divergence between quant build and local harness. If they match and we still see gaps then escalate to eng-runtime for kernel investigation.

anya: PR plan: add rerank-smoke config with seeds [101, 202], ndcg10_delta_vs_fp16 threshold 0.01, plus a tokenizer-parity check that runs early in the quant CI. I'll include instrumentation to log any characters that produced different token sequences.

sam: nice. Also add in docs: for compact quant models recommend pre-strip of HTML/MD during initial bring-up until we root-cause.

mia: uploaded diffs: https://files.redwood/test-repro/3501000002/token-diffs.zip (4 mismatches highlighted).

eval-bot: note: when normalizing input (strip html) q8 top-1 overlap with fp16 increases from 0.76 to 0.91 on short-factoid slice.

luke: good data. Next actions: mia uploads diffs + example inputs; anya opens PR for smoke tests and tokenizer parity; sam wires tokenizer parity into quant CI; i'll file a ticket for eng-runtime to investigate lower-level kernels only if tokenizer parity remains after we confirm token ids match.

mia: pairing offer: I'll be online this afternoon to work with anyone on repro.

anya: will submit PR with tests and html_strip profiling hooks.

luke: follow-up sync tomorrow 10:30am. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
